correctness.rationale: Projective changes normalize the three centers and a standard affine chart puts the unique rank-one point at the origin. In six independent affine coordinates, the four source maximal minors transform so that three are exactly the \(2\times2\) minors of a generic \(3\times2\) matrix and the fourth is their linear combination. A fresh SymPy reconstruction verified all determinant identities and the invertible coordinate substitution. The rank-one cone has dimension four, tangent space all six ambient directions at its vertex, Hilbert series \((1+2t)/(1-t)^4\), and degree/multiplicity three; its projective Segre base is smooth, so the cone is singular only at the vertex.

final_claim: For three cameras with linearly independent centers, the unique singular point of the line multiview variety has completed local ring isomorphic to the rank-one \(3\times2\) determinantal cone, equivalently the affine cone over the Segre \(\mathbb P^2\times\mathbb P^1\); in particular it is an isolated four-dimensional Cohen–Macaulay singularity of tangent dimension six and multiplicity three.
